# The remote of api is gone, so the sync of api fails. The tick writes an error row for api and goes on: web still gets its pull request.
# A name that the tick refuses (.hidden) gets no row at all, and the report says "No record" for it. The report posts once for the week.
[!exec:jq] skip
[!exec:sha256sum] [!exec:shasum] skip
isolate
maintinit
maintfakes
env HOME=$WORK/home
env GIT_BASE=file://$WORK/remotes
env UPKEEP_WEEK=2026-W44
cp settings-status home/.upkeep/settings.sh
cp repos-three.tsv home/.upkeep/repos.tsv
rm remotes/acme/api

exec sh home/.upkeep/scripts/tick.sh
stderr 'tick: skip bad name .hidden'
stdout 'item bump-web-2026-W44 finished'
stdout 'item report-2026-W44 finished'
! stdout 'item bump-api-2026-W44'
! stdout 'bump-.hidden'

grep '^2026-W44\tapi\terror\t\tsync failed: ' home/.upkeep/runs.tsv
grep '^2026-W44\tweb\topened\thttps://github.example/acme/pull/1\tdraft pull request\t' home/.upkeep/runs.tsv
! grep '.hidden' home/.upkeep/runs.tsv
! exists home/.upkeep/state/api.env
grep -count=1 '^update$' calls.log

# The report counts the error and names the repository that has no row.
grep '3 repositories listed. 1 opened a pull request, 0 skipped, 0 failed the gate, 1 had an error,' home/.upkeep/reports/2026-W44.md
grep '^- api: error \(sync failed: ' home/.upkeep/reports/2026-W44.md
grep '^## No record this week$' home/.upkeep/reports/2026-W44.md
grep 'The tick wrote no row for: .hidden\.' home/.upkeep/reports/2026-W44.md
grep -count=1 'gh issue comment 7 --repo acme/status' gh.log

# A second tick of the same week posts nothing more.
exec sh -c 'sh home/.upkeep/scripts/tick.sh || true'
grep -count=1 'gh issue comment 7 --repo acme/status' gh.log
grep -count=1 'gh pr create' gh.log

-- settings-status --
STATUS_REPO=acme/status
STATUS_ISSUE=7
-- repos-three.tsv --
api	acme/api	main	gotestsum --junitfile reports/junit.xml -- ./...
web	acme/web	main	JEST_JUNIT_OUTPUT_DIR=reports npm test -- --reporters=jest-junit
.hidden	acme/hidden	main	true
-- fixtures/npm.json --
{"left-pad":{"current":"1.0.0","wanted":"1.3.0","latest":"1.3.0"}}
